[E]wake up fine and dandy but then

feel my soul start leaving Like an
old man's hair receding
[E]I'm pleading, please, oh please On my
knees repeatedly asking Why
it's got to be like this
Is this living free?
[C]I don't wanna be don't wanna be the one to have the
sun's blood on my hands I'll tell the moon
Take this weapon, forged in darkness

asked forgiveness three times
